描述_EN: batik patterned cloths are worn by both men and women in java, the kain panjang being the skirt or waist cloth worn by men. batik is the name given in indonesia to the process of applying resist-dyed patterns to cloth. colour combinations of blue and white, red and white, and red and blue, as found in this example, which was probably made in cirebon, were common in batik cloths from the northern coastal area which had always been subject to considerable influence from external trade, both from the east (china) and the west (india). the main centres of production were the areas around the sultanates of surakarta and jogyakarta or yogyakarta in central java, and the coastal areas of cirebon, indramayu, pekalongan and lasem in the north and the area around garut in western java.
描述_ZN: 巴蒂克图案的布在爪哇男女都穿，Kain panjang是男性穿的裙子或腰部布。 蜡染是印度尼西亚对在布上应用抗染图案的工艺的称呼。 蓝色和白色、红色和白色、红色和蓝色的颜色组合，就像这个例子中发现的那样，可能是在井里汶制作的，在北部沿海地区的蜡染布中很常见，该地区一直受到来自东方（中国）和西方（印度）的外部贸易的巨大影响。 主要的生产中心是苏拉卡塔和日惹苏丹国周围的地区，以及北部的井里汶、英德拉马尤、佩卡隆安和拉塞姆等沿海地区和西部的加鲁特周围地区。
